result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The carousel and bottom-cut card are excluded per instructions. One clear content defect is the '-100%' discount badge on the pizza card, which looks like a data or logic error. There are also minor legibility and consistency concerns.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' badge, implying the item is entirely free. This is almost certainly a data or formatting bug, and it is misleading. It also lacks context about what is discounted.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value from the data source. Show the correct percentage (e.g. '-10%') or hide the badge when the value is invalid, and make clear what the discount applies to.

issues.description: The gray secondary text (delivery fees under the restaurant names, and the meta line '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') is small and light against the white background, so contrast is low. The white time pills over the light Green Bowl Poké image also have weak separation from the background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast. Add a subtle shadow or border to the time pills on light images.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the pizza card sits on a dark translucent circle, while on the ramen card the circle is nearly invisible against the dark image. The treatment is inconsistent and the icon's contrast varies with the image.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent button background, such as a semi-opaque fixed-color circle, so the favorite icon is always clearly visible.

issues.description: The decorative circles in the green promo banner are cropped awkwardly at the right and bottom edges. The bottom circle also appears to clip against the rounded corner with a visible hard edge.
issues.suggestion: Clip decorative shapes cleanly within the banner's rounded container, or adjust their placement.
